title: Communication Education Outreach Officer
description:
Are you looking for the right role for you? Then look no further

Communication Education Outreach Officer

Salary - £32,454 - £40,568 (plus benefits)
Hours - Full-time
Location - Essex, RM12 5 BF

As a Communication Education Outreach Officer at FCC Environment, you will play a key role in promoting environmental awareness, community engagement, and waste reduction initiatives. You will work closely with local communities, schools, businesses, and the Council to encourage sustainable practices, improve recycling performance, and deliver community benefit commitments.

This vacancy is for a full-time position, working 5 days per week.

Our promise to you
- Competitive salary
- 25 days' annual leave (full-time working) plus Bank Holidays
- Pension scheme
- Life insurance
- Discretionary bonus scheme
- On-the-job training and progression
- Recognition scheme
- Refer a friend
- Flexible benefits, including high street savings, cycle to work scheme and Gymflex membership, and many more (where applicable)
- Access to an Employee Assistance Programme and the Best Doctors Service via our Wellbeing Platform

What will you be doing?
- Manage the annual Community Benefit Plan and produce associated reports and trackers
- Ensure community benefit commitments are delivered to a high standard
- Manage funds used for community engagement and environmental initiatives
- Promote waste reduction and the Waste Hierarchy across the local community
- Support the Council in improving recycling performance and waste reduction initiatives
- Produce reports, presentations, educational materials, and communications
- Arrange and deliver waste education roadshows, school visits, and community events
- Assist with news articles and social media content relating to environmental services
- Develop relationships with local charities, community groups, and stakeholders
- Support environmental improvement projects, including tree planting schemes and carbon offsetting initiatives

What are we looking for?
- Experience of planning or delivering environmental education
- Proven track record of working to defined KPIs
- Understanding of financial budgeting
- Excellent administration and organisational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
- Confident presenter with strong communication skills
- Positive attitude and ability to work effectively with a range of stakeholders
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel, Outlook and Teams
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Knowledge of local communities, schools, and environmental issues would be advantageous

About Us

FCC Environment is one of the nation's leading waste and resource management companies. Committed to sustainability, we strive to minimise the amount of waste that ends up in landfill by transforming it into valuable resources wherever possible.

We operate over 200 facilities in England, Scotland and Wales and employ around 4,500 people.

The profile of the UK's recycling and waste management industry has never been higher. We need people who are up for the challenge to help us tackle climate change. We need people with ideas. We need you. Together we will meet the UK's waste management and energy recovery needs.

FCC Environment is an equal opportunities employer. We value diversity and are strongly committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants.

How to apply

So, if you want to advance or kickstart your career as a Communication Education Outreach Officer, please apply via the button shown. This vacancy is being advertised by Webrecruit; the services are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Digital Marketing Manager

Salary: £30,000 to £40,000 DOE
Location: Leigh-on-Sea, Essex
Working pattern: Full-time, Hybrid, 3 days in Studio/Office.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Digital Marketing Manager to join our creative agency and work across a varied portfolio of clients.

The core of the role is SEO and Google Ads, so you'll need strong practical experience delivering, managing and optimising organic and paid search performance.

You'll also manage website content through WordPress, including creating and updating pages, landing pages and blogs as part of wider SEO and digital strategies.

You'll work directly with clients and alongside specialists across social media, creative, brand and web to deliver joined-up digital activity.

This is a hands-on role. You'll need demonstrable experience across SEO and Google Ads and be able to discuss real examples of work you've personally delivered and the results you've achieved.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver SEO strategies, including technical, on-page and content-led optimisation
- Create, manage and optimise Google Ads, particularly paid search campaigns
- Research keywords, competitors and search opportunities
- Plan, write and optimise blogs and website content in line with SEO strategy
- Manage and update client websites, pages and landing pages through WordPress
- Use GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager to analyse performance and identify opportunities
- Monitor leads, conversions, acquisition costs and return on marketing spend
- Translate client objectives into practical digital strategies and campaign plans
- Report on performance and clearly communicate recommendations to clients
- Work alongside our social media, creative, brand and web specialists on integrated campaigns
- Use AI tools effectively as part of day-to-day digital marketing, research, analysis and content workflows

About You
- 3+ years' professional digital marketing experience, ideally within an agency or similarly varied environment
- Strong, demonstrable experience in SEO, and managing Google Ads and paid search
- Practical experience managing content through WordPress
- Experience writing and optimising blogs and website content
- Good working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager
- Experience using AI tools effectively within digital marketing workflows
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into practical insight and recommendations
- A good understanding of lead gen, conversions, CPA and ROAS/ROMS
- Confidence working directly with clients and managing multiple accounts and priorities

Additional Experience

Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:
- AI search, generative search and emerging search behaviour
- Meta Ads and other paid social platforms
- Organic social media management
- Email marketing, CRM and marketing automation
- LinkedIn and other digital advertising platforms
- Lead generation and conversion optimisation
- Editorial and content planning
- Creative campaign strategy
- Briefing developer, graphic design, video or photography teams
- Contributing to new business proposals and pitches
- Knowledge of popular web coding languages
- Knowledge of UI/UX

About Swan Creative

We're a creative agency based in Leigh-on-Sea, bringing together strategy, brand, creative, digital and technology.

You'll work across a varied portfolio of clients alongside specialists in social media, creative, brand and web, with the opportunity to take ownership of search performance and contribute to wider digital strategy.

What You'll Get
- £30,000 to £40,000 salary, depending on experience
- Full-time hybrid working, 3 days in the studio and 2 days remote
- A varied portfolio of clients and sectors
- An established creative, social and web team to work alongside
- Ownership of SEO and paid search performance
- The opportunity to contribute to wider digital strategy and help develop our digital offering

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Swan Creative , please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Social Media & Content Creator
description:
Job Title: Social Media & Content Creator

Location: Harlow, Essex - Office & site based

Salary: £28k - £35k Depending on Experience

Job Type: Permanent, Full

About us

SheaWorks is a fast-growing, family-run electrical and building services contractor working with some of the UK's leading property, managing agent and commercial organisations.

We are looking for a confident, creative and outgoing Social Media & Content Creator to join our team full-time.

We don't want corporate, boring social media.

We want someone who can capture the real personality behind SheaWorks - our engineers, our office team, the jobs we attend, the chaos, the laughs and everything that happens in between.

You'll need to be confident both behind AND in front of the camera, full of ideas and happy to get involved.

One day you could be creating funny, relatable content with the office team; the next you could be heading into London to meet one of our engineers on site and film a day in their life.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll take ownership of SheaWorks' social media presence and create regular, engaging content across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn.

Your role will include:
- Planning, filming, editing and posting social media content
- Regularly appearing in content yourself
- Creating funny and relatable office content with the SheaWorks team
- Travelling to jobs and meeting our engineers on site to capture real-life content
- Filming project transformations, behind-the-scenes footage and completed works
- Creating "day in the life" content with our engineers
- Coming up with challenges, trends, interviews and entertaining video ideas
- Creating educational content and simple electrical/property tips
- Interviewing engineers and team members on camera
- Keeping up with TikTok, Instagram and social media trends and adapting them for SheaWorks
- Producing Reels, TikToks, Stories, photographs and other short-form content
- Editing videos ready for posting
- Writing captions and scheduling posts
- Responding to comments and helping grow our online community
- Creating more professional content for LinkedIn alongside our fun social content
- Capturing company milestones, new starters, apprentices, training, team events and achievements
- Helping build the personalities of our engineers and office team online
- Tracking what performs well and creating more of the content our audience actually engages with

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for personality as much as experience.

You'll ideally be someone who:
- Is naturally confident and not camera shy
- Has a good sense of humour
- Is comfortable approaching people and getting them involved
- Understands what makes TikTok and Instagram content entertaining
- Can spot content opportunities without constantly needing to be told what to film
- Is creative and constantly thinking of new ideas
- Can film and edit short-form video to a high standard
- Is organised enough to maintain a consistent content schedule
- Is comfortable working in a busy office environment
- Is happy travelling to sites across London, Essex and surrounding areas
- Can switch between funny, informal content and polished professional content when needed
- Understands that sometimes the best-performing content isn't perfectly polished - it's real, relatable and entertaining

Experience using platforms or software such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe, TikTok and Instagram would be beneficial.

Experience within construction or electrical services is not essential - we'll teach you that.

We'd much rather find someone with the right personality, creativity and understanding of social media.

The Opportunity

SheaWorks is a growing, family-run electrical and building services business with a large team of engineers working across London, Essex and surrounding areas.

There's always something happening.

We want someone to come in and make our social media feel completely different from the typical construction company.

We want people to follow SheaWorks even if they don't currently need an electrician.

We want to show the personalities behind the business, create content people relate to and laugh at, showcase the work our team carries out and build a recognisable online brand.

You'll have a huge amount of creative freedom.

If you've got an idea and think it'll work, we want you to try it.

Important

This is not a remote social media role.

A huge part of the job is being around the SheaWorks team, capturing spontaneous content and getting out on site with our engineers.

You'll be based from our Harlow office and regularly travel to sites to create content.

You'll also need to be comfortable appearing regularly on SheaWorks' social channels yourself.

How to Apply

Don't just send us a standard CV.

Show us what you can do.

Send us your CV along with your TikTok, Instagram, portfolio or examples of content you've created.

We may ask you to send us a short video introducing yourself and telling us why you think you'd be perfect for SheaWorks, something to really get our attention!

We care just as much about your personality, ideas and creativity as we do about what's written on your CV.

Candidates with experience of; Social Media Manager, Content Creator, Social Media & Content Specialist, Digital Content Creator, Social Media Coordinator, Content & Social Media Executive, Digital Content & Social Media Manager, Social Media Strategist, Content Marketing Specialist, Social Content Manager will also be considered for this role.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager - Fashion Brand

We are partnered with a fast-growing UK fashion retailer known for its trend-led, affordable collections and strong digital presence. With a loyal customer base, frequent new launches and continued investment in ecommerce and customer experience, the business has established itself as a leading name in accessible fashion.

The Role:

This is a unique opportunity for a Social Media Manager to take ownership of the entire social media function for an exciting and growing fashion brand. You will be responsible for developing and delivering a multi-platform social media strategy, building a consistent and premium brand identity while driving meaningful engagement, brand awareness and commercial growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement the overall social media strategy, establishing clear objectives and growth plans across all platforms.
- Build and lead the social media function, managing and mentoring Content Creators and supporting their development.
- Own the brand's presence across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, creating tailored strategies for each platform.
- Develop a premium, aspirational social identity that appeals to a more mature fashion audience.
- Lead the planning, creation and delivery of engaging and commercially effective social content.
- Create, film, edit and publish high-quality video and photographic content across organic social and paid advertising.
- Lead creative direction for campaigns, product launches, seasonal collections and key brand moments.
- Plan and manage content shoots, including booking models, styling looks and coordinating production schedules.
- Work closely with the in-house photographer and wider Marketing team to deliver high-quality creative.
- Own the social media content calendar, ensuring campaigns, launches, Stories and promotional activity are planned and delivered effectively.
- Maintain a consistent brand identity, tone of voice and visual direction across all social channels.
- Analyse social media performance and use data and insights to continually improve content, engagement, reach and conversion.
- Identify new opportunities to grow the brand through social-first campaigns, trends, creators and innovative content formats.
- Stay ahead of developments across social platforms, fashion trends, consumer behaviour and algorithms.
- Confidently appear on camera when required and direct talent during content shoots.
- Work collaboratively with the wider Marketing and Brand teams to ensure social activity supports wider commercial and brand objectives.

About You:
- 3+ years' experience in social media management, ideally within a fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand.
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-platform social media strategies.
- Previous experience managing, mentoring or leading Content Creators or a social media team.
- A strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, including platform-specific best practice and emerging trends.
- Excellent video creation, editing and creative storytelling skills, with a strong portfolio of work.
- A highly creative eye with a strong understanding of premium fashion and lifestyle content.

Why Apply?
- Opportunity to build and shape the social strategy from the ground up.
- Lead and mentor a growing team of Content Creators.
- Work for an established and growing fashion and footwear brand with exciting plans for the future.
- Take ownership across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.
- Combine strategy, leadership and hands-on content creation in one role.
- Have real creative influence over the brand's premium and aspirational social identity.
